top_signals.title: Britain funds critical repairs to Chornobyl nuclear power plant damaged by Russian drone attack
top_signals.summary: UK to provide £17m in funding towards repairs to the Chornobyl nuclear power plant damaged by Russian drone strike last year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hackers steal customer data from major Russian hosting provider FirstVDS
top_signals.summary: Hackers have stolen passwords, access credentials and other sensitive data belonging to customers of Russian hosting provider FirstVDS after exploiting a vulnerability in software used to manage its servers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: California trucking owner pleads guilty in $2.1M identity theft scheme
top_signals.summary:
Nearly 100 people had their personal information compromised. Federal investigators traced the proceeds through international bank transfers before authorities arrested the operator following 18 months in Turkey.

top_signals.summary: US stocks are recovering some ground after last week’s rout in chipmakers, marking a positive start to a week in which earnings will put the artificial-intelligence trade to the test once again.
